title_vi: was/were (động từ to be ở quá khứ)
theory_html:
A. Example: Robert

A. Ví dụ: Robert

Now Robert is at work. At midnight last night he wasn’t at work. He was in bed. He was asleep.

Bây giờ Robert đang ở chỗ làm. Lúc nửa đêm qua anh ấy không ở chỗ làm. Anh ấy ở trên giường. Anh ấy đang ngủ.

am / is (present) → was (past):

am / is (hiện tại) → was (quá khứ):

  • I am tired. (now) → I was tired last night.

    Tôi mệt. (bây giờ) → Tôi đã mệt tối qua.

  • Where is Kate? (now) → Where was Kate yesterday?

    Kate đâu? (bây giờ) → Hôm qua Kate ở đâu?

  • The weather is good today. → The weather was good last week.

    Hôm nay thời tiết đẹp. → Tuần trước thời tiết đã đẹp.

are (present) → were (past):

are (hiện tại) → were (quá khứ):

  • You are late. (now) → You were late yesterday.

    Bạn đến muộn. (bây giờ) → Hôm qua bạn đã đến muộn.

  • They aren’t here. (now) → They weren’t here last Sunday.

    Họ không ở đây. (bây giờ) → Chủ nhật tuần trước họ không ở đây.

B. Positive, negative and question

B. Khẳng định, phủ định và câu hỏi

positive
khẳng định		negative
phủ định		question
câu hỏi
I / he / she / itwaswas not (wasn’t)was I / he / she / it?
we / you / theywerewere not (weren’t)were we / you / they?

  • Last year Rachel was 22, so she is 23 now.

    Năm ngoái Rachel 22 tuổi, nên bây giờ cô ấy 23.

  • When I was a child, I was scared of dogs.

    Hồi còn nhỏ, tôi đã sợ chó.

  • We were hungry after the journey, but we weren’t tired.

    Chúng tôi đã đói sau chuyến đi, nhưng không mệt.

  • The hotel was comfortable, but it wasn’t expensive.

    Khách sạn đã thoải mái, nhưng không đắt.

  • Was the weather nice when you were on holiday?

    Lúc bạn đi nghỉ thời tiết có đẹp không?

  • Your shoes are nice. Were they expensive?

    Giày của bạn đẹp quá. Chúng có đắt không?

  • Why were you late this morning?

    Sao sáng nay bạn lại đến muộn?

C. Short answers

C. Câu trả lời ngắn

Yes, …No, …
I / he / she / itYes, I / he / she / it was.No, I / he / she / it wasn’t.
we / you / theyYes, we / you / they were.No, we / you / they weren’t.

  • ‘Were you late?’ ‘No, I wasn’t.’

    ‘Bạn có đến muộn không?’ ‘Không.’

  • ‘Was Tom at work yesterday?’ ‘Yes, he was.’

    ‘Hôm qua Tom có ở chỗ làm không?’ ‘Có.’

  • ‘Were Sue and Steve at the party?’ ‘No, they weren’t.’

    ‘Sue và Steve có ở bữa tiệc không?’ ‘Không.’

mcq.question: I am tired now. I ___ tired last night.
mcq.full: I am tired now. I was tired last night.
mcq.vi: Bây giờ tôi mệt. Tối qua tôi đã mệt.
mcq.expl:
am/is (present) → was (past); are (present) → were (past).
am/is (hiện tại) → was (quá khứ); are (hiện tại) → were (quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: "last night" → quá khứ; I → was.
mcq.key: I am tired now. I ___ tired last night.|was
